criteria: All 5 PDFs open and checksums match imported snapshots
Inspected pages 1-2 of each PDF against extracted headings/text
Raw records/PDFs retained; figures/tables/references stay partial

NeurIPS long title, authors with numeric affiliations, diagrams. PDF pages 1-2 inspected: affiliations are front matter, Introduction body agrees. Figure captions and table cells retain partial status.

Microsoft preprint single-column with nested headings. PDF pages 1-2 inspected: Introduction, Background and RAG Approaches section labels match. Parent headings can have empty paragraphs; no claim of full hierarchy correctness.

IEEE two-column, bold abstract and many nested headings. PDF pages 1-2 inspected: detected two-column pages now read left column before right, section 2.1/2.2 paragraphs agree. Inline abstract and keywords are not separately recognized and stay in front matter.

followup_review: Final pilot headings and paragraphs rechecked against the same rendered pages after joining split heading numbers, retaining parent headings, and adding numeric citation contexts. No pilot paper has a NUL glyph. Partial-only acceptance remains in force.
